English: Totem Stake
A simple carved wooden stake marking a sacred site, where offerings are left to honor the spirits.
Ancestor Stone Circle
A ring of upright stones where the clan gathers to honor ancestors, deepening spiritual bonds.
Shamans Firepit
An enduring central fire where shamans perform rituals, strengthening clan unity and guidance.
Sacred Tree
A revered ancient tree, the heart of festivals and communion with the divine. Only permitted to those with some construction knowledge.
Spirits' Grove
A sacred grove maintained for ceremonies, attracting pilgrims and wise men from afar.
Prayer Pavilion
A vast, ornate tent where the faithful gather for regular worship, cementing the clans devotion.
Idol Sanctuary
A permanent wooden shrine housing revered idols, where offerings and vows are made by all clansfolk.
Blessed Yurt
A grand yurt adorned with sacred symbols, serving as the spiritual center for the nomad ruler and council.
Holy Grounds
An expanse of consecrated land preserved for major ceremonies and seasonal gatherings of the faithful.
Steppe Temple
A monumental temple complex of wood and stone, the ultimate testament to the clans faith and unity.
